name: labs/mcleu__pyapt
title: Thorlabs APT motion controller (PyAPT)
intro: Thorlabs APT motion controller (PyAPT), adapted from mcleu/pyapt. It reads `connected`, `stage_minimum`, `stage_maximum`, `stage_units` and 6 more; sets `position`, `acceleration` and `maximum_velocity`; runs `move_relative`, `home` and `stop_stage`. `move_relative`: move the stage relative to its current position; mRel waits for the move and the driver returns the position the controller reports afterwards. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/mcleu__pyapt --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/mcleu__pyapt --backend fake --mcp
